parsed.summary: Implementation of run825.py strictly follows PLAN-B72 sections C, E2, and E3. Exit rules for 8%/25% (intraday touch, gap-open handling, simultaneous SL/TP conflict resolution, 250d cap, delisting vs still-holding classification) are correctly implemented and verified against backtest_engine.simulate. Portfolio simulation correctly enforces realistic cash/slot constraints without look-ahead. E2 and E3 adoption decision logic exactly matches the approved criteria.
